name: INVINCIBLE
description: Mark Grayson is a normal teenager except for the fact that his father is the most powerful superhero on the planet. Shortly after his seventeenth birthday, Mark begins to develop powers of his own and enters into his father's tutelage.

videos.title: PRESENTING ATOM EVE SPECIAL EPISODE
videos.overview: In this special prequel episode, Samantha ‘Atom Eve’ Wilkins discovers her superpowers as a young girl - and must come to terms with her own sinister origins as she discovers a family she never knew she had.

videos.title: IT'S ABOUT TIME
videos.overview: When Mark Grayson finally inherits powers from his superhero father, it’s a dream come true. But there’s more to being a hero than just choosing a name and costume.

videos.title: HERE GOES NOTHING
videos.overview: With his father out of action, Mark struggles to defend the city against an interdimensional invasion, joining forces with a team of teenage superheroes.

videos.title: WHO YOU CALLING UGLY?
videos.overview: Mark has to cut a study date short to help save Mount Rushmore from a crazed scientist. Robot deals with Action - Comic as he assembles a new team of world-saving superheroes.

videos.title: NEIL ARMSTRONG, EAT YOUR HEART OUT
videos.overview: It's two firsts for Mark: a first date and a first trip to another planet. At the same time, Nolan and Debbie revisit their own first vacation together.

videos.title: THAT ACTUALLY HURT
videos.overview: Feeling confident in his new abilities, Mark risks a team-up with a local villain to take down a crime lord, while simultaneously juggling school and a new relationship.

videos.title: YOU LOOK KINDA DEAD
videos.overview: Mark joins William and Amber on a campus visit to Upstate University, hoping to discover a new future for himself. Debbie makes her own disturbing discovery.

videos.title: WE NEED TO TALK
videos.overview: Feeling lost and confused, Mark looks for advice from Eve. At the same time, everyone's looking for him.

videos.title: WHERE I REALLY COME FROM
videos.overview: Mark must prove he's become the hero he's always wanted to be by stopping an unstoppable force.

videos.title: A LESSON FOR YOUR NEXT LIFE
videos.overview: In the aftermath of his father's betrayal, Mark struggles with his responsibilities as Invincible and encounters an unexpected enemy.

videos.title: IN ABOUT SIX HOURS I LOSE MY VIRGINITY TO A FISH
videos.overview: It's summer break for Mark and his friends, but supervillains don't take a vacation. Mark is forced to face the consequences of Omni-Man's double life.

videos.title: THIS MISSIVE, THIS MACHINATION!
videos.overview: Mark starts his college career, Debbie struggles with personal trauma, and Allen the Alien returns home to find a new threat facing the Coalition of Planets.

videos.title: IT'S BEEN A WHILE
videos.overview: Mark answers the call to save an alien species, but the mission has unexpected personal consequences.

videos.title: THIS MUST COME AS A SHOCK
videos.overview: The Grayson household is upended when Mark returns to Earth with surprising new responsibilities. The Guardians of the Globe face dangers both at home and away.

videos.title: IT'S NOT THAT SIMPLE
videos.overview: After two challenging missions, the Guardians of the Globe struggle to work as a team. Meanwhile, Mark tries to balance his hero duties, personal relationships, and his future as a college student.

videos.title: I'M NOT GOING ANYWHERE
videos.overview: As Mark attempts to salvage his personal life, a new villain arrives, presenting Invincible with his greatest challenge yet. Donald grapples with his past.

videos.title: I THOUGHT YOU WERE STRONGER
videos.overview: An old enemy threatens everything Mark holds dear.

videos.title: YOU'RE NOT LAUGHING NOW
videos.overview: Mark Grayson is back and stronger than ever – with new enemies out for blood and old villains out for revenge.

videos.title: A DEAL WITH THE DEVIL
videos.overview: Mark takes a stand, unaware of the ramifications for his family, the GDA, and even the Guardians. Cecil remembers his past and Eve makes an important decision.

videos.title: YOU WANT A REAL COSTUME, RIGHT?
videos.overview: Mark struggles to teach Oliver what it means to be a superhero. Debbie explores a new relationship and a changed family dynamic.

videos.title: YOU WERE MY HERO
videos.overview: Two strangers ask Mark for help with a mysterious villain. Elsewhere in the galaxy, Nolan grapples with his identity and Allen finds a surprising new ally.

videos.title: THIS WAS SUPPOSED TO BE EASY
videos.overview: Mark and Eve start a business and encounter a familiar face. Debbie worries that Oliver's growing up too quickly.

videos.title: ALL I CAN SAY IS I'M SORRY
videos.overview: A powerful new figure challenges Mark's idea of what's right and what's wrong. Rae approaches Rex with a big life decision.

videos.title: WHAT HAVE I DONE?
videos.overview: Earth's greatest heroes join forces to fight an unimaginable threat.

videos.title: I THOUGHT YOU'D NEVER SHUT UP
videos.overview: With the world still reeling, a dangerous stranger arrives - testing Mark to his limits and beyond.

videos.title: MAKING THE WORLD A BETTER PLACE
videos.overview: Mark battles enemies new and old in his fight to keep Earth safe.

videos.title: I'LL GIVE YOU THE GRAND TOUR
videos.overview: Loyalties are challenged when an old enemy is revealed.

videos.title: I GOTTA GET SOME AIR
videos.overview: Consequences weigh on Mark. Oliver takes on a new job.

videos.title: HURM
videos.overview: Hurm.

videos.title: GIVE US A MOMENT
videos.overview: Mark embarks on a new and dangerous mission, throwing Debbie into a tailspin and plunging Eve into uncertainty.

videos.title: YOU LOOK HORRIBLE
videos.overview: Family bonds are put to the test. Under pressure, Allen makes a new friend.

videos.title: DON'T DO ANYTHING RASH
videos.overview: Nothing goes according to plan during a massive confrontation.

videos.title: DON'T LEAVE ME HANGING HERE
videos.overview: Mark confronts his darkest fears as his life changes forever.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 5 wins & 20 nominations total
